Calgary entered Monday at 23-20-8, seventh in the WHL Eastern race. It leaves at 24-22-8 (56 pts) with six goals for and eight against. The night went in three acts: a goaltending masterpiece, a one-goal heartbreaker and a firefight with the hottest team in the league.

Night totals:

  • WhiteoutI8I: 3G 2A, including the winner against Spokane
  • Koldex Bands: 4A

Finding a third scoring source is the job before Tuesday.

games.title: Hitmen Watch: XxPASTRNAK88 Shuts Out the Conference's Best
games.html:
Spokane came into Monday the way front-runners do: 36-13-2, 74 points, top of the WHL Western race. They left Calgary with nothing to show for it. Not a goal, not a point, not a crack in XxPASTRNAK88, who stopped all 11 shots for a 1-0 shutout.

It was a patient, suffocating game, and Calgary set the terms. The Hitmen had the puck in the attacking zone for 13:06 to Spokane's 6:18 and outshot the Chiefs 18-11. Spokane won the faceoff battle 12-4, but every possession it won at the dot seemed to end in the wrong zone. Through forty minutes the scoreboard was still blank. PRKz_Jugg was holding Spokane together at the other end and finished with 17 saves on 18.

The only goal came in the third period. WhiteoutI8I scored it with his only shot of the night, assisted by Gullyrr and Koldex Bands. Gullyrr was the engine all game, with 8 shots on goal from the middle of the ice. Calgary went 0-for-2 on the power play and didn't need it.

Calgary moves to 24-20-8 and owns the scalp of the night. Spokane ended the night 1-2-0 (37-15-2).

games.title: Hitmen Watch: Two Shots From xZainer89 Swing a Coin-Flip in Prince George
games.html:
On paper it was a draw. Shots were 13-13. Calgary had more of the puck (10:11 attack time to 7:50) and won the faceoff circle 15-5. But xZainer89 scored twice, and a game this tight only needs one player to break it.

The Cougars struck first, with xZainer89 scoring the only goal of the first period. The second period was a trade: Gullyrr scored Calgary's goal, set up by WhiteoutI8I and Koldex Bands, and xZainer89 scored his second. The 2-1 score then survived a scoreless third. Rshawzie closed the door with 12 saves on 13. Calgary's 0-for-2 power play is the line to circle: it was the chance to turn a coin-flip into a win, and it didn't land.

The Cougars played the more physical game, out-hitting Calgary 15-9, with Tibbytwo alone throwing 12 hits from the blue line alongside his assist. XxPASTRNAK88 was solid again with 11 saves on 13, but the Hitmen managed just one goal of support.

Prince George went 3-0-0 on the night and sits 33-20-1. Calgary slipped to 24-21-8 at that point.

games.title: Hitmen Watch: Calgary Trades Punches With the Night's Juggernaut, and Loses the Last Exchange
games.html:
Victoria spent Monday night erasing opponents. The Royals beat Lethbridge 7-0 and Moose Jaw 7-0, and nobody scored on nothargi4200 until Calgary showed up in the 10:10 slot. The Hitmen scored four times on him in one game, and it still wasn't enough.

Through two periods this was a real fight, tied 3-3. Gullyrr (2G 2A) and WhiteoutI8I (2G 1A) kept answering, Calgary converted its only power play (1-for-1), and nothargi4200 finished with 8 saves on 12. Then the third period went Victoria's way, 3-1. The Royals' top unit simply would not be denied. pickmasta ran the game from the left point with 1G and 5A. ProximalAbyss41 had 2G and 3A. redz_shifterr scored a hat trick and added an assist on 7 shots. All three finished +3.

Calgary was outshot 17-12 and outhit 9-3, and spent 6:48 in the attacking zone to Victoria's 10:14. XxPASTRNAK88 made 11 saves on 17 in his third start of the night. Koldex Bands (2A) and slang07 (2A) helped drive the offence.

Victoria finished the night 3-0-0 (31-21-2, 64 pts). Calgary ends the night at 24-22-8 (56 pts).

games.title: Four Goals From JP_029, and Medicine Hat Wins in Overtime
games.html:
This was a shootout between two snipers, with nothing settled until overtime. JP_029 scored four for Medicine Hat on 10 shots. lz0423 scored three for Kelowna and added an assist.
